ui.chat.clipped_row.cannot_expand.role: line under a clipped transcript row that this device cannot fetch in full (a row from another device's session)
ui.chat.clipped_row.cannot_expand.tone: short status line, no full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.final.role: status after the full output could not be fetched even after one retry; the clipped preview is final
ui.chat.clipped_row.final.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

placeholders.shown: size of the preview shown, already formatted (for example 1.2 MB)
placeholders.total: size of the full output, already formatted (for example 12.6 MB)

ui.chat.clipped_row.marker.role: line under a transcript row the server clipped because it was too large
ui.chat.clipped_row.marker.tone: short status line, no full stop

placeholders.total: size of the withheld entry, already formatted (for example 10.5 MB)

ui.chat.clipped_row.omitted.role: placeholder replacing a non-message transcript entry whose content was withheld because it was too large
ui.chat.clipped_row.omitted.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.open.role: link-style button that opens a dialog showing the full output of a clipped row
ui.chat.clipped_row.open.tone: short action label, imperative, no full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.cancel.role: button in the full-output dialog that stops loading and closes it

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.close.role: button that closes the full-output dialog

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.error.role: error in the full-output dialog when loading failed but can be retried
ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.error.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

placeholders.received: bytes loaded so far, already formatted
placeholders.total: size of the full output, already formatted

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.loading.role: progress text while the full output loads in parts
ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.loading.tone: short status line, no full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.progress_labe.role: accessible name of the progress bar in the full-output dialog
ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.progress_labe.tone: short noun phrase, no full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.retry.role: button that retries loading the full output

placeholders.total: size of the full output, already formatted

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.size.role: dialog description giving the full output's size
ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.size.tone: short noun phrase, no full stop

ui.chat.clipped_row.viewer.title.role: title of the dialog that shows the full output of a clipped transcript row
